Brand Marketing Manager

Lead our brand campaign across paid social, influencer partnerships, and seasonal launches. You will own the creative brief, the agency relationship, and the quarterly brand calendar.

Requirements: a degree in marketing or communications, five years of consumer brand experience, and a portfolio of campaign work with measurable lift. You will report to the Head of Marketing and manage two coordinators.

This role is on-site in New York and involves travel to shoots. Agency experience is strongly preferred.
